Hello there relief team,
The gate agent asked me to write about spare blankets

Please keep an eye on the storage shelf and make sure the folded blankets stay clean, dry, and ready for the next pet move. In the Companion Animal Travel Desk, these small checks matter because they help us keep the handoff smooth when passengers arrive from the skyports and need calm, practical support for their animals. When you notice a change in the condition of the blankets, note it right away in the desk ledger so the next shift can follow the same standard without guesswork.

If a traveler asks for an extra layer for a crate, offer one only after confirming that it fits the service record and will not block ventilation or interfere with the carrier latch. A simple, steady reply is usually best, especially when people are already focused on boarding and connection changes. We have seen that a neat stack of clean supplies helps set the tone for the entire desk, and it also reminds travelers that Aurelia Skyways is paying attention to the small details that keep pets comfortable.

Please also remember to return any borrowed blankets to the proper bin after use, and separate anything damp or soiled so it can be handled correctly later. If you are unsure whether an item should stay in circulation, set it aside and mention it in the ledger rather than guessing. Thanks for keeping the routine organized and for supporting the care we promise at the desk.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
